name: urgency
description: How close it is, ready to use as a heading: "Due in 7 days", "Due tomorrow" or "PAY TODAY"

name: daysAway
description: Days until the due date. 0 means today

name: billCode
description: The bill's own code, e.g. EXP-000006

name: billTitle
description: What the bill is for, as recorded

name: amount
description: The grand total, with its currency

name: dueDate
description: The date payment is expected, ISO

name: reference
description: The vendor's own invoice or reservation number, where one was recorded

name: safariName
description: The trip this bill belongs to, if any
